artifact_before_ref: Plan before pass 4 had a token algorithm requiring same scenario pack, host, method, debug setting and tokenizer, but did not require prompt hash/text as a hard pair key, same host runtime/build, same invocation settings, tokenizer version/accounting spans, baseline/adaptive isolation, repeated-run variance handling, complete trace schema, privacy/redaction handling, and explicit invalid-pair/quality-regression failure outcomes. REVIEW.jsonl row 4 was ledger-only.

findings.summary: Token before/after methodology was not rigorous enough to prevent invalid paired comparisons or token-only overclaims.
findings.required_fix: Add a hard paired-run methodology gate covering identity, host/runtime sameness, method/settings, tokenizer/accounting, isolation, variance, trace schema, privacy/redaction, and failure handling.

findings.summary: REVIEW.jsonl row 4 was ledger-only and did not point to an inspectable evidence packet.
findings.required_fix: Create review-pass-04.md/json and update only row 4 with evidence packet refs and ledger_rows_are_evidence=false.

recheck_evidence: Plan requires same scenario_id, canonical prompt_text, prompt_text_sha256, method, host/runtime/build, debug setting, tokenizer name/version/accounting scope, baseline/adaptive isolation, repeated-run variance handling, full trace schema, privacy/redaction status, and failure classifications.
Plan states tokens cannot prove quality and token savings count only after quality non-regression or improvement for the same scenario pair.
Plan states token delta alone cannot close runtime readiness, semantic quality, model readiness, target promotion, rollback, or learnability.
REVIEW.jsonl row 4 points to review-pass-04.md/json and sets ledger_rows_are_evidence=false.
